contexts.text: They who are in inmost perception are in the perception of all things which are beneath, for the things beneath are nothing but derivations and compositions therefrom...
The doctrine of faith without the life of charity has in it that brotherhood with one lower than themselves seems to be beneath them.
When I was in (the light of Heaven), bodily and worldly things appeared as if they were beneath me...
What is said to be under or beneath = what is outside.

So far as the Natural has drawn... from the Rational, it regards sensuous things... as beneath itself... But in so far as the Natural has drawn... from the sensuous things of the body, it regards rational things as beneath itself...
They who are not in confirmed falsity... easily admit truths... and afterwards see falsities as it were beneath them...
All things which are beneath are called servants... AC 5305.
Nothing that is beneath can do anything from itself...
Every external thing is there presented as below... Hence Hell appears below.
Relatively to the Angels, Heaven is around or outside, that is, beneath, for what is around is also outside, and what is outside is also beneath.
Their inward man is closed above and open below. (See Close.)
From beneath () = from what is exterior, for that which is outside is expressed in the Word by beneath. References.
The Spirits who are below Heaven are filled with wonder when they hear and see that Heaven is below as well as above...
When the Internal of man is open... only below...
The affections of the thoughts, and thence the sounds of the discourse of the Angels of Heaven, are heard below in the World of Spirits variously...
Good from the Lord is above or within; (evil from the parents) is below or without...
What is below is also without, and what is without is around.
